'''Carlos Ray "Chuck" Norris''' (born March 10, 1940) is an American martial artist, actor, film producer, and screenwriter. Known for his role on the TV series ''Walker, Texas Ranger'', Norris has been a popular cultural figure, also recognized for his conservative viewpoints and activism.

==Controversies and Conspiracies==
Norris has occasionally been at the center of controversy due to his outspoken views and writings. He has been associated with various conspiracy theories, often sharing opinions that align with far-right ideologies. In some of his op-eds and public appearances, Norris has expressed skepticism about mainstream scientific consensus, including topics like climate change.

Norris has also been linked to controversies regarding his statements on religion and politics. As a devout Christian, he has advocated for traditional family values, which has sometimes led to criticism from more progressive circles.

==Connection with Alex Jones==
Chuck Norris has made several appearances on platforms that feature controversial host Alex Jones, known for his conspiracy-driven content. While Norris has not explicitly endorsed all of Jones's views, his presence on such programs has been noted by both fans and critics alike. These appearances have fueled speculation about Norris's alignment with certain fringe theories, although he often emphasizes his focus on patriotism and personal responsibility.

==Personal Life and Philanthropy==
Outside of controversy, Norris is involved in various charitable endeavors, including programs to support military personnel and anti-drug campaigns. He continues to maintain a significant fan base through his work in entertainment and activism.
